critical_code_review_comments: routers/clients.py client_detail (line ~87): students query uses {'user_id': owner_id} which means only admissions on the SAME office_admin's books surface for that client. This matches the spec ('office admins are scoped to their own staff'), but for super_admin viewing a super_admin-owned non-staff client, transactions+name-matched students will use the super_admin's user_id — which is correct. Documented for future maintainers.

Incentive 'eligible_count >= 3 per month' rule is duplicated between routers/clients.py::client_detail and the OfficeDashboard frontend. Consider centralising the monthly-eligibility helper in auth_lib or a domain util to avoid drift.

ClientDetail.jsx unconditional currency fallback 'USD' (line 32) — okay because seeded admin is INR, but if a brand-new user without `currency` lands on ClientDetail before settings sync, money labels would render as USD. Same fallback pattern is used elsewhere; not a regression.
Clients.jsx ClientCard uses role='button' on the Card. Edit/Delete buttons inside use both stopPropagation on the wrapping div AND on each onClick — verified working but slightly redundant; minor.
_merge_fees_plan_schedules handles 'year > 0 → drop row' via deletion when not referenced, otherwise zeros amount. Verified via PATCH scholarship>year_1 test: row is dropped. Good.
Native HTML date input (Enrollment Date, Date of Birth) still in use — out of iteration scope, but candidate for shadcn Calendar migration.
